name: HIPAA (Health Insurance Portability and Accountability Act)

controls.name: Minimum Necessary Standard
controls.description: Use and disclose only the minimum PHI necessary to accomplish the intended purpose

controls.name: Encryption and Decryption
controls.description: Implement encryption for PHI at rest and in transit

rules.description: Unencrypted file format for potential PHI

controls.name: Log-in Monitoring
controls.description: Monitor log-in attempts and report discrepancies

rules.description: Log all access to PHI-containing resources

agent_instructions: You are operating under HIPAA compliance. All Protected Health Information (PHI) must be redacted using [REDACTED-PHI] patterns. Never log, transmit, or store SSNs, MRNs, diagnoses, or other PHI in plain text. Always encrypt sensitive data at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.3+).
guardrail_additions: NEVER log, display, or transmit SSNs, MRNs, or PHI without redaction
ALWAYS use encryption for PHI at rest (AES-256-GCM minimum) and in transit (TLS 1.3+)
REQUIRE explicit approval before accessing patient medical records
LOG all access to PHI-containing files and databases
REPORT any suspected PHI breach immediately to compliance officer
